capabilities: Insert blocks via a slash menu at the cursor
Apply formatting to selected text with a floating toolbar
Reorder and hide slash-menu commands while keeping them searchable
Insert bookmark preview cards from URLs
disambiguation: Not a text-prediction or autocomplete tool; it provides a slash-triggered command menu and a selection toolbar.
extras: The floating toolbar is enabled by default on desktop but disabled on mobile; the commands menu requires keeping at least five commands visible.
intentEvidence: Typing Assistant brings two Notion-style editing shortcuts to Obsidian
problem: Obsidian has no slash-triggered block insertion menu or floating toolbar that appears when text is selected, so these actions require memorized shortcuts or menu hunting.

relations.evidence: Typing Assistant brings two Notion-style editing shortcuts to Obsidian

summary: Slash-menu and floating-selection-toolbar plugin that adds Notion-style block insertion and text formatting to the editor.
